notes: Feed Rates: 'Mollasses' and 'Wheat Polland' are named Molasses and Wheat Pollard; 'Sunflower' is Sunflower Cake; 'Potatoes' is Feed Potatoes because Potatoes is already a crop Item.
Feed lot rations: 'Stocklick' (1 %) is Vital Nyama, the mineral the Daily Feed Tracker feeds at about 1 % of the ration; Feed Rates has no stock lick of its own.

Feed lot rations: doses follow the NB box (Diamond V 7 g, Meat grow 60 ml a head); Meat boost is 50 g, the top of its 25-50 g range and what the sheet's own total (10.75 kg / 215) works out to. A dose is given to a group only where the sheet feeds that additive to it.
Shoats ration: the groups mix sheep and goats (Medicine Cost names ewes, rams and he goats in one dosing) but a herd has one species; they are seeded as Sheep.
Daily Feed Tracker: 1 rows have a date that fits nowhere in the sequence and were skipped.
RFID tabs: 982 091086140099 appear twice in one tab; the row with more weighings is kept.

RFID tabs: the farm's groups and the tab names disagree. Feed lot rations say Growers are 150-279 kg and Finishers above 280; the tabs split the growers at 250 (250-up / 250-down) and hold 385 animals against 217 Finishers and 173 Growers on the tracker. The bands are taken from the tab names (Finishers from 280 kg) and the ration sheet (Growers from 150 kg); each tagged animal goes to the band of its latest weight, which gives Finishers 203 and Growers 182. The 250 split is two weighing lists inside Growers, not a herd boundary.
New stock RFID: 22 animals bought at Rumuruti on 2026-10-17 go to Quarantine, at the cost the tab gives each; the tab does not say their sex, and feedlot stock is seeded Male.

Calves data: joined to the Breeders calf rows by label ('2211B'), then dam and birth date, then SA tag; its typed day-first birth dates and its sex win. 4 calves are only on Calves data and are added. Its DAM column holds the calf's own label where it reads like '2211B'.
Calves data: tag 131865 appears twice (27 July and 30 August, both to dam 2722); the first is kept, the second has no tag of its own and is skipped.
Calves data: row 9 has no tag, no dam and no sex; skipped.

Calves data: tags 131003, 131000, 131012, 130980 are also on other Breeders animals (Breeders has SA 1000 on the bull 2215A, Calves data puts 131000 on the calf 2215B). Breeders' tag is kept; the calf is joined by its label or its dam and birth date and keeps no tag.

Breeders: the sex of 2 young animals (44, 2216A) is on neither sheet nor deducible from the dam's 'calves produced'; Animal needs one, so they are recorded Female with 'SEX NOT IN THE TRACKER' in the remarks for the farm to correct.

Breeders: 51 (calved 2026-09-05), 44 (calved 2026-10-12), 2722 (calved 2026-07-27), 2740 (calved 2026-09-10) are 'Pregnant' on Breeders but calved since (Calves data); a cow with a calf under the 210-day separation age is suckling it, so they go to Lactating, repro status Open.
Breeders: calf rows 104 have no category and nothing else; skipped.

Breeders and Calves data are seeded as animals: 32 cows and heifers, 36 calves, weaners and a bull. The ID is the SA ear tag ('SA-913'; Calves data's 130913 is the same tag) and the old tag is the burn name; a cow with no SA tag is 'TAG-<old tag>' and a calf with none 'CALF-<label>', the label being the farm's dam-tag-and-letter ('2721A'). Pregnant cows go to In-calf, lactating ones to Lactating, the three dry cows (they calved in March and are neither milking nor recorded pregnant) to In-calf, and the not-pregnant heifers to Heifers. Calves and weaners go to a new Calves herd (class Calf, a Livestock Settings calf herd); the separation-due list then asks for the weaners to be moved. The breeding bull runs with the Lactating cows. Herds: Calves 35, Heifers 4, In-calf 11, Lactating 18.

Breeders: no cow has a breed, date of birth, arrival or source, and no pregnant cow has an expected calving date or a diagnosis date, so no Pregnancy Diagnosis events are made: repro_status says Pregnant and nothing more. Parity is the 'Number of Calves Produced'; the last calving date is her youngest calf's birth date. Heifer weights have no date and go in the remarks, not as weighings. The 'Sire Tag No.' column under Calves holds the dam's SA tag, and is read as that.

Steers sold 2026: 169 sales. Each date is read in the month its block heads ('1 June' and the rows under it); 0 rows fit no reading in their month and keep their first one. Tags reused across months ('29' sold in June and again in August) are different animals: a sold animal with no RFID is 'SOLD-<tag>-<yymmdd>'. Oct-Nov sales give RFID digits ('140171', '40244' for 140244, '401137' for 140137) and are the RFID animal itself.

Steers sold 2026: carcass sales (700 or 620 KES a kg of carcass; every rate over 450 is one, marked 'carcass weight' or not) give the live weight in the tag cell. The disposal's exit weight is the live weight and its price per kg the total over it, so its sale price is the sheet's total; the carcass weight and rate are in the reason.
Steers sold 2026: (no tag) 202 kg; (310kg) 126.45 kg cannot be tied to an animal (no tag or no date) and are not seeded.

Moyale sold: 173 starters weighed 2026-02-05, 2026-03-05, 2026-04-06, 2026-05-07 and marked Sold, with no sale date or price. Each is disposed as Sold on its last weighing date at that weight, with no price (the seeder records it without the price check a live sale needs); the reason says the date and price are unknown. Repeated tags in the list ('37', '80', '21') are separate animals.

Breeders sold: 76 heifers and cows with no sale date, price or dated weight. Their last dated fact is the CBPP vaccination (2026-10-06); each is disposed as Sold on that day, without a price, and the reason says so. Their undated weights are the exit weight only.

Old New stock, Old finishers, Old growers, Finishers sold: 176 rows are animals still on the farm (matched to an RFID animal by old tag, e.g. '74/ R 769' to MOL769, and only where the RFID animal's first weighing can follow the row's last) and give it its earlier weighings, arrival and treatments; 116 rows are animals sold on Steers sold 2026 and give the sold animal its weighings; 2 rows are dead on the sheet; 237 rows match nothing on the farm or in a sale, or match more than one, and are not seeded (no exit is recorded for them, so creating them would put animals on the farm that are not there); 44 rows matched one animal together with another row whose weighings cannot be the same animal's, and were left out.
Weighing columns are dated by their headers, each the earliest reading at least two weeks after the one before; a number under 80 kg in a weighing column is a gain and is ignored.
Moyale sold: 3 starters marked Sold are in an RFID tab today (by old tag, with weights that follow on); they are those RFID animals, not sales.

Medicine Cost, shoat side: 12 rows are kept in the JSON (medicine_shoats) and not seeded. None names a shoat group ('all shoats', '82 weaners, 37 rams and 16 he goats'), most are before the groups' opening count (7 June 2026), and the herd-level record (Herd Treatment) always issues stock; splitting a dose across groups would be invented.

Medicine Cost, steer side: the arrival drugs (oxytetracycline, dexamethasone, buparvaquone, Ivanor) are the Old New stock columns and are seeded per animal from there, as Treatment events with no drug lines, so nothing is issued and nothing waits to be. The bloat treatment of 'MOL 802' on 27 May 2026 (catasol, liquid paraffin, epsom salt) is seeded if MOL802 is an animal; the 'FMD @50/head', 'PPR' and 'Deworming forty heifers' lines name no animals.

Health: 470 events (Vaccination, Deworming, Treatment), each on one animal and backdated, with no drug lines: a history record issues nothing and leaves nothing to reconcile. Fotivax on '25/12/26' is Christmas 2025 (its next dose is due June 2026); CBPP is 6 September (old feedlot sheets) and 6 October (Breeders), as Excel stored them, matching Medicine Cost's order. 'Every Tuesday' Duodip dipping is a routine with no date and is not an event.
Fuel Cost: only the Mixer Wagon has litres; its cost per litre (166.0 KES) is given once.

Daily Feed Tracker: on its latest day (2026-11-09) only Finishers, Growers, Incalf, Lactating and Heifers are fed; Starters/Breeders (ration sheet: 94) have not been fed since August/September and are seeded with no head beyond tagged animals.
